measurements.name: White Blood Cell Count
measurements.lowRecommendation: Low white cell count: rest, extra hand hygiene, avoid sick crewmates; repeat the count in 48 hours and tell the Crew Medical Officer if it is below 3000.
measurements.highRecommendation: High white cell count can mean infection: check temperature and symptoms, alert the Crew Medical Officer.

measurements.name: Lymphocyte Count
measurements.lowRecommendation: Low lymphocytes raise infection and virus reactivation risk: protect sleep, hygiene, repeat in 48 hours; below 600 alert the Crew Medical Officer.
measurements.highRecommendation: High lymphocytes can follow a viral infection: log symptoms and repeat in 48 hours.

measurements.name: Body Mass Change
measurements.lowRecommendation: Body mass is falling: eat missed meals, add protein, complete resistance exercise; recheck in 1 week. Worse than -5% alert the Crew Medical Officer.
measurements.highRecommendation: Body mass is rising: review food log and fluid retention; recheck in 1 week.

measurements.name: Grip Strength Change
measurements.lowRecommendation: Strength is dropping: add a resistance session and check exercise logs; recheck in 1 week. Worse than -15% alert the Crew Medical Officer.
measurements.highRecommendation: Unusually large increase: repeat the test to rule out a measurement error.

measurements.name: Intraocular Pressure
measurements.lowRecommendation: Very low eye pressure is unusual: repeat the reading and alert the Crew Medical Officer if below 6.
measurements.highRecommendation: Eye pressure is high: lower cabin CO2, avoid straining, repeat within 24 hours; above 25 alert the Crew Medical Officer for an OCT scan.

measurements.name: Retinal Thickness Change
measurements.lowRecommendation: Retina is thinning: repeat the OCT scan and send images to the flight surgeon in the next downlink.
measurements.highRecommendation: Retina is thickening, an early sign of SANS: daily near-vision check, lower CO2, repeat OCT in 1 week; above 55 alert the Crew Medical Officer.

measurements.name: Stand Test Systolic Drop
measurements.unit: mmHg fall in systolic pressure on standing (rise is negative)
measurements.lowRecommendation: Blood pressure rose sharply on standing: rest, repeat the test in 30 minutes and tell the Crew Medical Officer if it repeats.
measurements.highRecommendation: Blood pressure fell on standing: drink 1 litre of water with salt, sit before standing, repeat in 30 minutes; a fall of 20 or more alerts the Crew Medical Officer.

measurements.name: Resting Heart Rate
measurements.lowRecommendation: Heart rate is low: repeat after 5 minutes of rest; below 40 with dizziness alert the Crew Medical Officer.
measurements.highRecommendation: Heart rate is high at rest: rest, hydrate, repeat in 5 minutes; above 120 alert the Crew Medical Officer.

measurements.name: Ejection Fraction
measurements.lowRecommendation: Heart pumping is reduced: repeat the ultrasound and alert the Crew Medical Officer; send images to the flight surgeon.
measurements.highRecommendation: Unusually high value: repeat the scan to check the measurement.

measurements.name: Sleep Duration
measurements.lowRecommendation: Not enough sleep: fix the sleep schedule, dim lights before bed; under 6 hours for 3 nights alerts the Crew Medical Officer.
measurements.highRecommendation: Sleeping much longer than usual can signal illness or low mood: log how you feel and tell the Crew Medical Officer if it continues.

measurements.name: Memory Score Change
measurements.lowRecommendation: Memory and attention are lower than baseline: protect sleep and retest in 1 week; worse than -20% double-check critical tasks and alert the Crew Medical Officer.
measurements.highRecommendation: Large improvement: likely practice effect; no action.

measurements.name: Balance Score Change
measurements.lowRecommendation: Balance is worse than baseline: slow head movements and retest in 24 hours; worse than -25% no EVA, rover driving or robotics until normal.
measurements.highRecommendation: Large improvement: repeat the test to check the measurement.

measurements.name: Mood Score
measurements.lowRecommendation: Mood is low: take private time, call family, exercise; 3 or lower, or 3 low days in a row, alerts the Crew Medical Officer and offers a private session with the psychologist.

measurements.name: Solar Proton Flux
measurements.highRecommendation: Solar storm under way: move toward the most shielded area, postpone EVA, check dose every hour; at 100 or more shelter now and alert the Crew Medical Officer.
